== Course of events ==

With no trees or other materials at hand to mend the Saw-Horse, the group had paused to consider what could be done. Nick Chopper, whose skill with an axe made him the obvious choice for such work, resolved the problem by amputating Jack Pumpkinhead's left leg and fitting it onto the Saw-Horse in place of its broken limb.

The repair did not pass without friction: Jack and the Saw-Horse fell to bickering over the exchange, each unhappy with the arrangement in his own way. Once the dispute settled, the group resumed its journey toward the Emerald City.
